source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue autonomous LeanFrontier development. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT re-inspected live upstream after the previously selected Markov Fibonacci branch merged concurrently, found the promoted roadmap targets completed, and audited natural consumers of the newly accepted Kochen-Stone theorem. Mathlib v4.34.0 contains the standard second Borel-Cantelli theorem under full independence but no pairwise-independent counterpart. The new module proves the classical pairwise-independent second Borel-Cantelli lemma by bounding the Kochen-Stone second-moment denominator by S_N^2 + S_N and showing the Kochen-Stone ratio has limsup at least one when S_N diverges. The theorem assumes only pairwise independence of distinct measurable events and concludes that their limsup has probability one. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored the Lean statement and proof; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
